text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
A giant tower appears almost out nowhere in Astraea.
Yui, Makoto, Kasumi and {0} set out to
uncover the truth behind the mysterious structure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
突如アストライア大陸に現れた、謎の建造物。
{0}とユイ、マコト、カスミの４人は
その巨塔へ向けて歩を進めていた──

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
So this is what the Tower of Luna looks like up close.
This place is our ticket to regaining Mr. Knight's memories, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれがルナの塔……
騎士クンの記憶を取り戻す鍵が、
あそこにあるんだよね、
マコトちゃん。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text: Sure seems like it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
そうみてえだな。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
It matches up almost perfectly with the tower mentioned
in that old book we found a while back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この前見つけた古文書に出てきた
塔の話とも一致してるし、
間違いねぇだろ。

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text: Indeed. There's no room for doubt there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに関しては、
疑う余地はないだろう。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
And with that said, now we just need to make our way in.
Yui. The place mentioned in that book was around here, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってことで、
あとは塔の中に入るだけなんだけど……
ユイ。
古文書に書かれてたのは、
このあたりだよな？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
There should be a shrine that'll guide us to the entrance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
塔への道筋を照らす祠があるって。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
There's too many monsters to make it by boat.
And there wasn't a proper entrance as far as we could see, either.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海は魔物だらけで船じゃどうにもならねぇし、
見た限り入り口らしい入り口なんてどこにもなかったからな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Hopefully we can find a clue or two—
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
何か手掛かりがあるといいんだけど──

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Mr. Knight? Where are you going?
Huh? There's something strange over there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
騎士クン、
どこに行くの？
え？　
妙なものがある？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Oh. Does this have warp magic built into it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
これって、
もしかして
転送魔法の術式かな？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't seem like it's active though, does it?
Hey, {0}. You might not wanna get too close.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けどこれ、
発動してなくねぇか？　
って、おい{0}、
むやみに近づくなよ。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! It just activated out of the blue!
What's the deal here?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おわっ！？　
転送魔法が急に発動し始めやがったぞ！
一体なんだってんだ！？

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
I have a theory, Makoto.
The spell seems to have reacted to his presence.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マコトさん。
私には今、
この術式は助手くんの存在に反応したように見えたよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: That proves the tower has some sort of connection to him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ということは、
やっぱりこの塔は、
騎士クンに関係しているんだね！

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's all jump in at the same time!
Is everyone ready? Then let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし！　
みんなで一斉に、
ここに飛び込んでみようじゃないか！
準備はいいかい？
　いくよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui, Makoto & Kasumi
text_block_list.text: One, two, three!
text_block_list.orig_name: ユイ・マコト・カスミ
text_block_list.orig_text: せーのっ！！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Uhh, where are we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
んぅ……
えっと、
ここは……？

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Sure looks like the inside of the tower to me.
Haha! We did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
塔の中で間違いなさそうだな。
ははっ、
やったぜ！

text_block_list.name: Kasumi
text_block_list.text:
That went well. And now that we're inside,
it's time to uncover the mysteries that lay ahead.
Let's get exploring, shall we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うまくいったね。
では、
楽しい謎解きの時間の始まりだ。
内部の探索を開始しようじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Makoto
text_block_list.text:
Aww yeah!
Time to finally get to the bottom of what's going on with
{0} and his memories!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おうよ！　
{0}の記憶の謎は、
あたしたちが解き明かしてやるぜ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Mr. Knight!
We might just find something crucial in here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
行こう、
騎士クン！
この塔を調べて、
騎士クンの記憶を取り戻そうよ！
